In App Copy:
Race Across the Southbank
London is full of spooky sites. Your team's mission is to discover them, bring them to life and send us Spectral Evidence of your findings.

Your Mission: At each checkpoint, your team must complete a spooky creative task and capture the Spectral Evidence. Only then will the next checkpoint be revealed.

Win Conditions: Your team will be judged on imagination, collaboration, creativity and sheer audacity — not just speed.
 
Health and Safety: This game involves taking grroup photos on a phone - please be mindful of traffic, pedestrians and cyclists!

Step 1: Join a team. Find the team you are in and add your name. Everyone in your team can play from their own phone, or share one. 
 
Step 2: Choose your captain. Choose someone on your team to gather evidence and submit to HQ.

Step 3: Find your Starting Point. To see your starting point, piece together this puzzle. You can play separately or together to solve it.
When you find the loction that is in the jigsaw, press the [x] button to take a picture of your team with  Spectral Evidence, and share the image with HQ (Whatsapp).
Congratulations! You have unlocked Checkpoint 1 - Find this image

Find a stairwell, doorway or other liminal space. This is a portal to another world. What will come out of it when the bell tolls? Send us your group photo as Spectral Evidence, with a short description, to HQ.

Decipher this riddle: Before this concrete house stands a man frozen as the gloomy prince of Denmark. He was this theatre's first director. Name him and find him. Send us your group photo as Spectral Evidence, with the riddle's answer, to HQ.

Look left, look right. Choose any public art in the area and reimagine it as a spooky Tourist Trap - if it came alive, what would it do? Send us your group photo as Spectral Evidence, with a short description, to HQ.
